evidence.raw_input: Studied Computer Science at State University, graduated with honors. Built a course-scheduling app used by 200+ students as a capstone project.
Joined Initech Software as a Backend Engineer, working primarily in Python on the payments platform.
Led the redesign of the payments API to support multi-currency transactions, using Python and SQL. Reduced p99 latency by 40%.
Built a CLI tool with Docker-based staging environments to automate deploys, cutting release time from 2 hours to 15 minutes.
Moved to Northwind Analytics as a Senior Software Engineer, leading a small team on customer-facing analytics products.
Tech lead for a 4-person team building a realtime analytics dashboard with React, JavaScript and WebSockets, coordinating scope and project management across two other teams.
Maintain a small open-source CLI tool for converting CSV to JSON, currently around 500 GitHub stars.
Read Designing Data-Intensive Applications. Deep dive on distributed systems tradeoffs, replication and partitioning.
Gave a meetup talk, Scaling Payments at Initech, on public speaking and presenting technical work to a mixed audience.
Attended KubeCon 2026, focused on Kubernetes operations and platform engineering talks.
Earned the AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate certification.
Wrote a design doc for splitting our monolith's payments module into a separate service.
Started learning GraphQL to modernize our API layer at work.
Set up Terraform for our infrastructure-as-code migration this quarter.
Mentoring two junior engineers on system design now.
Kicked off a proof-of-concept for migrating batch jobs to serverless functions.

career_goals.description: Get comfortable enough with GraphQL and Terraform to lead the API modernization project end-to-end.
Move into a Staff Engineer role: mentoring across multiple teams and owning platform-level technical strategy rather than a single team's roadmap.
Either lead engineering for a small, focused team, or go independent as a consultant specializing in backend infrastructure and platform migrations.

career_vision.content: I want to spend my career at the intersection of backend infrastructure and the teams that depend on it — deep enough in the systems to make good platform calls, close enough to the people using them to know which problems are actually worth solving.

resume_exports.content:
# Resume

## Self PR

Backend-leaning software engineer with experience spanning payments infrastructure, realtime analytics platforms, and open-source tooling. I care most about making systems that are boring to operate — clear ownership, low-latency payments paths, and deploy tooling that lets a team ship without fear.

## Work History

### Northwind Analytics / Product Engineering
Senior Software Engineer (2023-01-15 – Present)

- **Realtime analytics dashboard** — Tech lead (2023-03-01 – Present)
  Leading a 4-person team building a realtime analytics dashboard with React and WebSockets.

### Initech Software / Platform Engineering
Backend Engineer (2019-07-01 – 2022-12-31)

- **Payments API redesign** — Lead backend developer (2020-02-01 – 2020-09-01)
  Rebuilt the payments service to support multi-currency transactions, reducing p99 latency by 40%.
- **Internal deploy tooling** — Contributor (2021-03-01 – 2021-06-01)
  Built a CLI to automate staging deployments with Docker, cutting release time from 2 hours to 15 minutes.

## Other Projects

- **csv2json (open source)** — Maintainer (2022-01-01 – Present)
  Maintain a small open-source CLI tool for converting CSV to JSON, around 500 GitHub stars.

## Education

### State University
B.S. Computer Science (2015-09-01 – 2019-06-01)
Graduated with honors. Built a course-scheduling app used by 200+ students as a capstone project.

## Skills

- **Certification**: AWS Solutions Architect
- **Domain Knowledge**: Distributed Systems
- **Management**: Project Management
- **Soft Skill**: Mentoring, Public Speaking
- **Technical**: API Design, CLI Tooling, Docker, GraphQL, JavaScript, Kubernetes, Python, React, SQL, Serverless, Terraform, WebSockets

## Certifications

- AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate (2025-11-05)
